# LoadoutSlot.Index property

Stable game-defined identifier passed to [`ApplyAsync`](../../Stellar.Abstractions.Services/ILoadout/ApplyAsync.md). This is the game's loadout/project id, not necessarily a positional index; see the loadout recon findings.
